newsitem.title: INDIA: HOCKEY-DUTCH ADD CHAMPIONS TROPHY TO OLYMPIC CROWN.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-DUTCH ADD CHAMPIONS TROPHY TO OLYMPIC CROWN.

text.p: The Netherlands launched an early assault to beat World Cup hockey champions Pakistan 3-2 in the Champions Trophy final on Sunday, adding to the Olympic title they won in Atlanta last July.
The Dutch, the only unbeaten side in the tournament, recaptured the trophy after a 14-year gap by seizing a 3-0 lead in the first 20 minutes.
Pakistan staged a splendid rally to cut the margin to 3-2, but could not go beyond.
Teun de Nooijer in the ninth minute, Van Pelt Wouter in the 13th and Bran Lomans in the 20th scored for the Dutch before Rahim Khan (25th) and Mohammad Usman (28th) replied.
Defending champions Germany whitewashed hosts India 5-0 in a play-off for the third place and Olympic silver medalists Spain beat Australia 5-2 to take the fifth spot. Australia finished last.
